name: The Tampa EDITION
positioning: Contemporary EDITION hotel in Tampa's Water Street Tampa neighborhood, with a Chef John Fraser restaurant, rooftop dining and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led hotel with several restaurants and bars in Water Street Tampa
Guests who enjoy rooftop dining and cocktails

facts.text: The hotel is situated within the Water Street Tampa neighborhood.
The building was designed by New York-based architecture practice Morris Adjmi in collaboration with Florida-based firm Nichols Brosch Wurst Wolfe & Associates.
Lilac has an open kitchen and an eight-seat chef's counter designed by Christian Liaigre.
Azure at EDITION offers Sunday brunch.
Market at EDITION serves fresh pastas and Neapolitan-style pizzas.
Market's Coffee Bar serves La Colombe coffee and house-made pastries.
The Lobby Bar offers billiards, cocktails, wine and craft beers.
Arts Club is a lounge with craft cocktails, shareable bites and curated musical entertainment.
Punch Room serves cocktails that can be enjoyed by the glass or in a punch bowl.
The gym has floor-to-ceiling views and fitness equipment, with private training and classes by appointment.

highlights.text: The interiors were designed by Roman & Williams, with the project built on the creative vision of Ian Schrager.
Lilac is a Mediterranean restaurant helmed by Chef John Fraser, using Floridian ingredients.
Azure at EDITION is a rooftop restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows serving seaside-inspired Greek cuisine.
On weekends the rooftop Pool Bar becomes an al fresco cocktail lounge with rotating musical entertainment.
The spa uses a signature black tea fragrance created exclusively for EDITION by Le Labo.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the urban location may have city noise.
